name: bearing
description: Carries a purpose the human fixed into any Claude Code session, with no build step. A SessionStart hook injects the frame, the outstanding baton, this unit's per-repo corpus fences (drift-intra / drift-inter / working-delta / unpushed / checkpoint-stale) and the open-todo count; a UserPromptSubmit hook states the baton's reading procedure once, before the first turn does anything else; a PostToolBatch hook re-states the facts when the corpus moves under a session; a PreCompact hook stops silent auto-compaction once so a baton can be authored instead. Ships the aim / handoff-r / handoff-w skills. No build step, no server, no daemon.
